NEW ONLINE SELF-SERVICE PORTAL

https://benefitscal.com/ is the new online self-service portal to apply for, view, and renew benefits for Medi-Cal, CalFresh, CalWORKs and Refugee Cash Assistance programs. 

Please note that the following self-service online portals are no longer available:

  • MyBenefitsCalWIN (MyBCW)
  • Customer Automated Response System (CARS)
  • Virtual Kiosk (Program Integrity Division (PID) and In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS)
  • eCF37
  • eSAR7

Clients can create a BenefitsCal.com account to submit applications, renewals, and verifications, as well as to view their case information.

For information on how to create a BenefitsCal account, visit BenefitsCal: How to create an account - YouTube.

  • BenefitsCal.com (CalFresh, CalWORKs, Refugee Cash Assistance (RCA), Medi-Cal)
  • Covered California (Medi-Cal only)
  • GA Online Application (General Assistance (GA) only)
  • Send a request to reschedule your CalWORKs and/or CalFresh appointment online here.
